idea-plugin.name: CRA Readiness Audit for EU Cyber Resilience Act
idea-plugin.description:
Flags the lines in your repo that break the EU Cyber Resilience Act - default passwords, disabled TLS checks, floating base images, an expired security.txt - naming the Annex each one fails.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → CRA Readiness Audit for EU Cyber Resilience Act: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 28 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/cra-readiness-audit (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/cra-readiness-audit

action.text: CRA Readiness Audit for EU Cyber Resilience Act: Check This File
action.description: Run CRA Readiness Audit for EU Cyber Resilience Act on the file in the editor
